Explicit P_gg>0 on h,g>0, P_h>=12 and P(h,0)>0 give strict convexity in g, strictly increasing global minimum with h, and exactly one threshold double root. Exact rational sign witnesses at h=21/250 and positive global quadratic support bound at h=17/200 isolate h*; all h below have exactly two positive simple roots, above none. The reported decimals are approximations to the unique algebraic solution, not definitions. Independent generator calculations match exact expressions, not only numerical root fitting.
